authority: User explicitly requested joint HV, IGD+ and bidirectional C assessment
scope: All prospective performance, ablation and progression protocols; no algorithm change

coverage.relation: exact weak dominance, all a[k] <= b[k]; equality included
coverage.emptyPolicy: missing or invalid comparison, not invented coverage

HV_IGDplus: Common frozen per-instance normalization; frozen HV references and disclosed common empirical IGD+ reference
IGDplusSymmetricWorsening: 200*(IA-IB)/(IA+IB); both zero gives0; positive is worse, not conventional relative change
reporting: Raw per-seed metrics, paired effects, within-instance summaries, reference sensitivity, failures, tails and costs; same-FE and same-time separately

interpretation.aligned: Joint benefit only when effects are meaningful and robust under the next preregistered protocol
interpretation.conflicting: Report tradeoff; no overall win from HV alone or a2-of3vote
interpretation.uninformative: Do not demand strict improvement of a metric that cannot distinguish fronts; do not claim it favours the candidate

frozenRunPolicy: Append dated supplementary analysis only; retain original source, metrics, gates and stopped decisions unchanged
